paragraphs: Abba, son of Rav Binyamin bar Chiyya. End of Rosh Hashanah, 35a; Niddah 13a. He asked Rav Huna bar Chiyya (bar Rav Minyomin, Chullin 80a), in Rav Assi’s time. Abba, son of Rav Minyomi bar Chiyya, recited a teaching, end of Yevamot 122b; bar Minyamin, Sotah 38b. Rabbi Abbahu entered Arbel and was received by Abba bar Binyamin, Shevuot, chapter 6, halakhah 3 [located in Shevi’it 6:3:5].
